## findplus config get
Print the value of KEY from config.env, or empty if unset.

**Usage:** `findplus config get [OPTIONS]`

## findplus config list
Print all KEY=VALUE pairs in config.env.

**Usage:** `findplus config list [OPTIONS]`

## findplus config path
Print the path to config.env.

**Usage:** `findplus config path [OPTIONS]`

## findplus config set
Write KEY=VALUE to config.env after validating through Settings.

**Usage:** `findplus config set [OPTIONS]`

## findplus config unset
Remove KEY from config.env.

**Usage:** `findplus config unset [OPTIONS]`

## findplus db current
Print the current Alembic revision of the database.

**Usage:** `findplus db current [OPTIONS]`

## findplus db path
Print the absolute path to the SQLite database file.

**Usage:** `findplus db path [OPTIONS]`

## findplus db upgrade
Run Alembic migrations to head. Safe to run repeatedly (idempotent).

**Usage:** `findplus db upgrade [OPTIONS]`

## findplus devices
List every tracker Find+ knows about and choose which ones to track.

**Usage:** `findplus devices [OPTIONS]`

| option | default | help |
|---|---|---|
| --track |  | Track this device id (repeatable). |
| --track-all |  | Track every device on the account. |
| --untrack |  | Stop tracking a device id. |
| --default |  | Device the dashboard opens on. |
| --refresh |  | Re-query Find Hub for the list. |
| --json |  | Print the device list as JSON. |

|---|---|---|

## findplus export

| --all |  | Export the entire history. |
| --device-id |  | Limit to one device. Omit for all devices. |
| --group |  | Export every member's track (never merged). |
| --output, -o |  |  |
